verdict: key consistent: 56 signs = 56 letters, 51/51 repeated occurrences, 16 shapes for 16 letters, no homophones; the single sign on 31r l.14 is the ا of the first عادوا, written under the line as an insertion.
notes: Text as enciphered = the record's: مرضت لله قوم ما فيهم من جفاني / عادوا وعادوا وعادوا على اختلاف المعاني. عادوا is spelled the same three times (ع ا د و ا: Mt Hd Wl Xd Hd), as the record expected from the repeated runs.

31r l.14: the single dotted-zigzag sign stands below l.13 directly under the space between Mt and the following loop (31r_l13.png): it is the omitted ا of the first عادوا, read in that place (in the alignment it is placed inside l.13).
Lam-alif loops are letters, not ligatures: the single loop is م (6 times), the joined pair is ل (5 times, لله twice). ف and ق are told apart by dots (hollow cross with or without four dots).
Counts by eye: 31r l.11 10, l.12 10, l.13 8 + l.14 1; 31v l.1 11, l.2 9, l.3 7 = 56 (record 59). 12 dividers for the 12 word ends inside the text.
